vocabulary.definition: partially melted, not completely liquid nor solid
vocabulary.example: The lava flowing from the volcano was semi-molten, creating a dangerous situation for nearby villages.
The supervolcano beneath Yellowstone is a geological behemoth capable of immense destruction.

vocabulary.definition: the upper layer of the Earth's mantle below the lithosphere
vocabulary.example: The movement of tectonic plates is influenced by the flow of material in the asthenosphere.

vocabulary.definition: the capability of an eruption to explode violently
vocabulary.example: The volcanic explosivity index measures the explosivity of volcanic eruptions on a scale from 0 to 8.

vocabulary.definition: involving or causing great damage or suffering
vocabulary.example: The catastrophic eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD buried the city of Pompeii under ash and pumice.

vocabulary.definition: an extremely large volcanic eruption that ejects more than 1,000 cubic kilometers of material
vocabulary.example: The supereruption of Mount Tambora in 1815 led to the Year Without a Summer due to the ash blocking sunlight.
